posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
I really wanted to thank all participating members of the Holography Forum for keeping the energy alive in the interest of holography. So I was thinking of a way to return that energy, what about have hologram auction? Donate a hologram or (what ever) to go on the auction block, and either have a closed bid auction or live action (similar to the ebay type auction). What do you guys think, it might be a good way to show our work, as well as do good things for the forum. I know its probably easer to just send Colin a donation to help support the forum (I’ll do that any way), but after all were here because we like to make and/or see holograms………….

Would any one else be interested in participation?

Possibly a good time to have it would be during the week of December 25 thru January 1 (as this is when we had most viewers on line)

posts.author: Sogokon'A
posts.content_md:
That’s a very good idea. Members of the forum spend not only their forces but also time and money. That time is often taken from the work giving money!

Second, existence of such auction is an incentive to action. I, for example, was sitting and thinking whether I should start realizing my new method of obtaining Lippman’s photos or not that I have in mind for a good while already. Nobody needs this work. But now I know what to do! As initiative I can offer a rarity for auction – the first and only Lippman’s image of the Sun made in 1986.

Besides, I could suggest an exclusive stained-glass window as Lippman’s image of world-famous “Windows” for Bill Gates’ office door. The foreground color will depend on lightning conditions as well as on observation angle i.e. it will change with each opening the door. Size 60х80 cm.
